summary: Iteration 43 - Monitor de Procesos (AI Evaluation Jobs) tested end-to-end. Backend: 20/21 pytest cases passed, 1 skipped (no ineligible package in DB). Frontend: /monitor UI verified for Dev, access control enforced for Agent/Proveedor (sidebar hidden + redirect + toast).
critical_code_review_comments: SSE endpoint uses double-quoted string-escaped JSON in f-string; works but fragile — consider json.dumps() for safety against injection/formatting in status values.
cancel_job returns generic 400 even when job doesn't exist at all; differentiating 404 vs 400 (wrong state) would improve client UX.
list_jobs fecha_hasta concat '<date>T23:59:59' assumes fecha_creacion stored as ISO string — confirmed matches enqueue_job which stores isoformat(). OK.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — recommend migrating to lifespan context manager (FastAPI 0.110+) to avoid deprecation warning in logs.
WebSocket /api/ws/dashboard failing on every page load (console warning) — unrelated to Monitor feature but recurring noise; worth a separate fix.
seed_data_creation: None — one manual job was enqueued during test via POST /api/ai-evaluation/jobs/manual using an existing journey, which became visible in Monitor IA UI (MX-XScH4jJZYt, 0/31, Evaluando, 81%).
